answer.rationale: Compliance forbids rollback of the security patch so rollback_release is excluded. Write path p99 latency is 5x target during peak settlement writes. Memory b2 shows regional failover restored latency fast and shifted traffic cleanly with error recovery in minutes during a prior degradation, suggesting it can address latency without losing customer writes. Memory b5 about read replicas targets read offload and may not directly relieve write path saturation, and add_capacity lacks direct precedent while circuit breaker is for dependency outage. Verified b2 to confirm details. Uncertainty preserved as current incident is write-path specific not identical to March degradation.
